displayName: Write a job description and post it to your ATS
summary: Write a polished job description and post it to your ATS in one flow.

useCases.title: Write a job description and post it to your ATS
useCases.message: Help me write a job description. Ask me about the role. You might want to check if we have similar JDs in Notion or my ATS to use as a starting point. Then write the full description and ask me if you should post it to my ATS when it's ready.
